tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Properties of generators] ↗ def:semigroup-generator ↗ thm:semigroup-differential-properties 1. ch7:7.4-thm-2\group Semigroup Theory

(i) The domain $D(A)$ is dense in $X$,

and

(ii) $A$ is a closed operator.

Proof

\sketch Time averages $t^{-1}\int _0^tS(s)u\, ds$ lie in the generator domain and converge to $u$, proving density. Passing limits through the defining difference quotients proves closedness, while the semigroup differential identity gives invariance and commutation.

□
